description: Where a context menu was requested and what it applies to: the gesture's client point plus the cell (Row/Column) or the sheet (SheetIndex). Raised by TmSpreadsheetCanvasGrid / TmSpreadsheetSheetTabs when their RenderContextMenu is false, so the host can render the menu as a SIBLING of the layout container — the container's containment would otherwise reposition the menu's position:fixed surface.
